The '''''Panthac''''' was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Mandator III-class dreadnought|''Mandator III''-class dreadnought]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the ''Panthac'' and the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Whelm]]'' destroyed each other above the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] during a [[Battle above Alsakan|battle]] part of the [[Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Panthac'' was mentioned in [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s [[2012]] book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.<ref name="TEGTW" />
